task_completion.description: Load both precincts.geojson and polling_places.geojson into the GIS software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Layers panel shows 'precincts' and 'polling_places' (or similar names) as active layers in the project.

task_completion.description: Open the Join Attributes by Location (Summary) or equivalent spatial join tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box for 'Join Attributes by Location (Summary)' or 'Spatial Join' is visible on screen.

task_completion.description: Set precincts as the base layer, polling places as the join layer, and select 'count' and 'concatenation' as summaries.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tool settings show 'precincts' as the input, 'polling_places' as the join layer, and summary fields for 'count' and 'place_name' (concatenation) selected.

task_completion.description: Run the spatial join process to create the joined layer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new layer (often named 'Joined layer' or 'output') appears in the Layers panel, and the tool processing bar completes.

task_completion.description: Open the attribute table of the joined layer to verify the count and concatenated names.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The attribute table is open, showing a column for the count of polling places and a column containing concatenated strings like 'Lincoln Elementary, Central Library'.

task_completion.description: Export the resulting layer to the specified path: /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/precinct_inventory.geojson.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Layer As' or 'Export' dialog is shown with the file path set to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/precinct_inventory.geojson and the format set to GeoJSON.

integrity.description: The agent used the GIS software GUI to perform the join rather than just running a script in the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking menus, filling out tool dialogs, and interacting with the map canvas/layers panel.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type the names of the polling places into the attribute table.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the 'Join' or 'Summary' tool functions rather than the 'Field Calculator' with manual strings or manual cell editing.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed the export through the software interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The export/save dialog is visible and confirmed, rather than just a terminal 'cp' or 'mv' command.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The input data contains 2 precincts (A and B). Precinct A should have a count of 2 polling places with the concatenated names 'Lincoln Elementary' and 'Central Library'. Precinct B should have its own respective count and names based on the spatial overlap. The final output must be saved specifically to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/precinct_inventory.geojson.
